summary: ESUHSD urges the FCC to preserve E-rate funding, rejecting proposals to sunset or cap the program. The district relies on E-rate to maintain broadband infrastructure and access to digital learning resources for thousands of students. The comment emphasizes the importance of maintaining robust E-rate funding and streamlining compliance to ensure that the program remains a reliable cornerstone of American K-12 education. The comment cites the successful outcomes of the program for East Side Union High School District and urges the Commission to avoid unfunded operational mandates.

claims.argument: Without E-rate support, millions of dollars would have to be diverted from classroom instruction
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-rate support, millions of dollars would have to be diverted directly from classroom instruction, student support services, and educator compensation to cover basic telecommunications infrastructure
